blacklistabilityReview.evidence: NXUSD direct controls were re-examined under the FreezeWatch decision procedure (docs/blacklist-tracker.md) before applying the reserve fallback. At Avalanche97945563 (hash0x29e60db7db9bda6ca6b0722c948d3ccc38add149f5ec84df69d30844a5a0cc40, 2026-10-19T06:36:08Z), canonical token0xf14f4ce569cb3679e99d5059909e23b07bd2f387 has owner0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467, totalSupply18963850.983822079394713991 and zero EIP1967 implementation/admin slots. Exact verified NXUSD.sol plus BoringERC20 source expose ordinary transfers, owner-only mint/mintToBentoBox and caller-only burn; no token proxy, upgrade dispatcher, blacklist, transfer pause, arbitrary-holder burn or holder-exit restriction exists. Polygon0xf955a6694c6f5629f5ecd514094b3bd450b59000 is verified non-proxy NXUSDV2 with the same issuance/selfburn model; withdraw only transfers tokens already owned by the token contract. At Polygon95792660 (hash0xb0632086badc44489f41f2e36f1c3625b318f534eb24cf0653a7e4ae66e14fa0, 2026-10-19T07:18:57Z), owner0xc4eca7d55db3dc217a2edfff3da05fca4d8a7ef8 and supply1546000 were independently read. Polygon is9.3923% of circulation in the supply data; raw supply fraction is7.537841%, with a different denominator, but both deployments were examined regardless. No declared parent claim exists. Token source URLs: https://api.routescan.io/v2/network/mainnet/evm/43114/etherscan/api?module=contract&action=getsourcecode&address=0xf14f4ce569cb3679e99d5059909e23b07bd2f387 ; https://polygonscan.com/address/0xf955a6694c6f5629f5ecd514094b3bd450b59000#code (exact source retrieved through Etherscan v2 chainid137). The live bundle https://nxusd.nereus.finance/js/app.60bde321.js lists16 Avalanche market rows, while official deployment manifests add legacy markets omitted from that frontend. The independently measured16-row debt total at numeric Avalanche97945563 is7040536.420471147154571174. Dominant WXT market0xd70bfc49f4a293920c8642e97217807a0132284b alone reports totalBorrow elastic/base4974640945623375000000000, or4974640.945623375, with collateral0xfcde4a87b8b6fa58326bb462882f1778158b02f1. This same raw debt was reproduced at numeric97947156 and97948011; an auxiliary Routescan tag=latest result19432.1911938413 and resulting61.30%/82.16% partial percentages were contradicted by pinned RPC and are rejected, not used. WXT's exact verified MintSwapCanonicalToken/MultiBridgeToken has burn(from,amount) without holder allowance, and owner-settable updateBridgeSupplyCap. At97945563 owner is the same2-of-3 Safe0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467; getOwners enumerates0x90bd1ecd6cf2cf87552c870e403f71cafde0cd90,0xa91c2397677b726e727befdd6bf047d03ee35db8,0x8c355e95b533a508e309efa4af4b26e000ab76a6 and getThreshold=2. The current admitted bridge0x88dcdc47d2f83a99cf0000fdf667a468bb958a78 is a verified PeggedTokenBridge whose public burn passes msg.sender to WXT.burn, so that member alone is not arbitrary-holder-capable; however the assigned issuer-token owner can admit a caller that invokes the existing burn(from) against arbitrary holders. WXT therefore has a qualifying issuer-controlled Possible basis, not merely DAO governance or mint-only authority; the full debt share counts under the FreezeWatch decision procedure (docs/blacklist-tracker.md). Verified WXT and bridge source use the same Routescan getsourcecode endpoint for those addresses. DAI.e and aAvaDAI count categorically under the FreezeWatch decision procedure (docs/blacklist-tracker.md); av3CRV is entirely DAI/USDC/USDT, so all constituents qualify and value-splitting cannot change its100% qualifying fraction. Same-pin Curve pool0x7f90122bf0700f9e7e1f688fe926940e8839f353 underlying_coins(uint256) enumerated DAI.e0xd586e7f844cea2f87f50152665bcbc2c279d8d70,USDC.e0xa7d7079b0fead91f3e65f86e8915cb59c1a4c664,USDT.e0xc7198437980c041c805a1edcba50c1ce5db95118; index3 reverts. DAO-only Aave/BENQI governance is not the counted basis; the terminal stablecoin issuers are. Conservatively count WXT4974640.945623375,WBTC.e409927.608254264792715669,BTC.b531314.561325243268970728,DAI.e153.551128801405580977,USDC182497.852160412510292820,av3CRV0.1005,aAvaUSDT50120.21626794042436726,aAvaUSDC94544.979689850565399255,aAvaDAI50250.994049828297334945,qiUSDCn9900.175057323399988135 and PolygonWBTC0.1005, totaling6303351.084557039664649789. Primary manifest directory: https://github.com/nereusfinance/nereus-stablecoin-core/tree/e75e91b072a9d2346503383aafa2d40abc7ea582/deployments/avalanche . Four Polygon clones at95792660 add WMATIC176.056832373191831126 (0x233b0c4e5866a04974e0ed56261954606bc4d09b),WETH0.1005 (0x726cbd3d7552563bd2eaff4f6818b422582de1ae),WBTC0.1005 (0x1be3fa93a236040fa1d3f6bf0389f4aca5b454f4),NRS718675.5 (0xe36ee25cbb653c445b912fc081a959d867f560d7), totaling718851.757832373191831126. Known combined debt7805611.309007026935697548 yields a qualifying lower bound80.75409901% ONLY WITHIN THAT PARTIAL SET. For unknown additional debt M, the whole-system lower bound would be6303351.084557039664649789/(7805611.309007026935697548+M); the missing-debt threshold for a guaranteed strict majority is M<4801090.860107052393602030. With no defensible finite bound on M, unconditional whole-system percentage bounds remain0-100. AV+Polygon raw supply20509850.983822079394713991 gives a supply-denominated30.73328563% sensitivity; this does not cross50 even under a hypothetical total-debt<=supply cap. That cap is not proven: NXUSD/NXUSDV2 ownership can mint independently of debt, selfburn independently destroys token supply, and market elastic debt includes accrued interest. Both mint(to,amount) and mintToBentoBox(clone,amount,box) are owner-only with15%-per24h rate limits, not a masters-only debt-linked issuance invariant. Missing joins: exhaustive per-chain clone/debt inventory, all11 Polygon frontend market labels joined to clones, whether Base's empty frontend network has any actual market/token deployment, and owner mint/idle inventory/escrow reconciled to live debt. Do not substitute totalCollateralShare (BentoBox shares) or totalSupply for the required debt-weighted collateral denominator. No follows: no positive Upstream or direct Possible verdict is inferred from missing reserves.

oracleRisk.summary: NXUSD's 17 debt-bearing Avalanche Cauldrons use collateral-specific Chainlink, LP, TWAP, or staking-rate oracle routes without a common freshness check or alternate provider; a false oracle result preserves the Cauldron's cached rate, while a reverting route blocks the update.

branchApplicability.rationale: The pinned Nereus Avalanche deployment manifest contains 17 Cauldrons, and all 17 retained nonzero totalBorrow at finalized block 90297313. They share the Cauldron liquidation engine but have distinct collateral, oracle, LTV, and liquidation-multiplier configurations, so the live set is represented as one fully enumerated common-engine branch rather than inferred from the protocol-level Chainlink announcement.

branches.fallbackBehavior: Nereus oracle wrappers generally read Chainlink latestAnswer or latestRoundData without checking updatedAt, answeredInRound, or a heartbeat, and there is no alternate provider. Cauldron updateExchangeRate keeps its prior cached rate only when oracle.get returns false, as the xJOE TWAP can before initialization or its 10-minute period; an oracle revert propagates and blocks the operation. Owner-swappable ProxyOracle implementations are administrative replacements, not automatic failover.

branches.liquidationMechanism: The cited CauldronV2 source, re-read 2026-10-20, requires liquidatorManager.info(msg.sender).isAllowed before liquidation. An approved liquidator updates the exchange rate, checks insolvency, repays selected NXUSD debt parts and receives corresponding BentoBox collateral shares at the market liquidation multiplier. The previous any-caller description was unsupported by that same source; no current complete deployment or approved-liquidator census is inferred.
branches.backstop: The reviewed deployments and cited Cauldron source define no Stability Pool, insurance pool, or automatic protocol-funded shortfall backstop. The cited engine relies on an approved liquidator supplying NXUSD in exchange for seized collateral.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: The Cauldron subtracts only the borrow parts selected and repaid by a successful liquidation. Debt that is not economically liquidated remains assigned to borrower positions and continues accruing; the reviewed source defines no global settlement or automatic write-off. The NXUSD owner Safe retains a rate-limited direct mint path, but that privilege is not an automatic bad-debt mechanism.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Nereus issued distinct owner-mintable NXUSD contracts on Avalanche and Polygon. No lockbox or third-party bridge contract was identified, so the two deployments are treated as issuer-native issuance rather than one bridged token.
